package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted = "student.diagnostic-result.committed.v1"
const DiagnosticResultCommittedSchemaV1 = 1
const MaximumDiagnosticResultEventBytes = 4096

// DiagnosticResultCommittedEvent is an aggregate locator, never a score or
// an authority for placement. Student's result must be read before placement.
type DiagnosticResultCommittedEvent struct {
	EventID       string                        `json:"event_id"`
	EventType     string                        `json:"event_type"`
	CorrelationID string                        `json:"correlation_id"`
	CausationID   string                        `json:"causation_id"`
	StudentID     string                        `json:"student_id"`
	OccurredAt    time.Time                     `json:"occurred_at"`
	SchemaVersion int                           `json:"schema_version"`
	Data          DiagnosticResultCommittedData `json:"data"`
}

type DiagnosticResultCommittedData struct {
	PlanID       string `json:"plan_id"`
	PlanRevision int    `json:"plan_revision"`
	PlanDigest   string `json:"plan_digest"`
	ResultDigest string `json:"result_digest"`
}

func DiagnosticResultCommittedEventID(planID string) string {
	return uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceURL, []byte(SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted+":"+planID)).String()
}

func ValidateDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(event DiagnosticResultCommittedEvent) error {
	if event.EventType != SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted || event.SchemaVersion != DiagnosticResultCommittedSchemaV1 || !canonicalUUID(event.EventID) || !canonicalUUID(event.StudentID) || !canonicalUUID(event.CausationID) || !canonicalUUID(event.Data.PlanID) || event.CorrelationID != event.Data.PlanID || event.EventID != DiagnosticResultCommittedEventID(event.Data.PlanID) || event.Data.PlanRevision < 1 || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(event.Data.PlanDigest) || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(event.Data.ResultDigest) || !canonicalUTCMicro(event.OccurredAt) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

// DecodeDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent rejects duplicate keys, nulls, extra
// fields, alternate timestamp spelling, trailing data, and oversized bodies.
func DecodeDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(body []byte) (DiagnosticResultCommittedEvent, error) {
	var event DiagnosticResultCommittedEvent
	if len(body) == 0 || len(body) > MaximumDiagnosticResultEventBytes {
		return event, ErrValidation
	}
	envelope, err := strictDiagnosticObject(body, []string{"event_id", "event_type", "correlation_id", "causation_id", "student_id", "occurred_at", "schema_version", "data"})
	if err != nil {
		return event, err
	}
	if _, err = strictDiagnosticObject(envelope["data"], []string{"plan_id", "plan_revision", "plan_digest", "result_digest"}); err != nil {
		return event, err
	}
	if json.Unmarshal(body, &event) != nil || ValidateDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(event) != nil {
		return DiagnosticResultCommittedEvent{}, ErrValidation
	}
	var timestamp string
	if json.Unmarshal(envelope["occurred_at"], &timestamp) != nil || timestamp != event.OccurredAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano) {
		return DiagnosticResultCommittedEvent{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return event, nil
}

func strictDiagnosticObject(body []byte, fields []string) (map[string]json.RawMessage, error) {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body))
	first, err := decoder.Token()
	if err != nil || first != json.Delim('{') {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	allowed := make(map[string]bool, len(fields))
	for _, field := range fields {
		allowed[field] = true
	}
	values := make(map[string]json.RawMessage, len(fields))
	for decoder.More() {
		token, err := decoder.Token()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		key, ok := token.(string)
		if !ok || !allowed[key] || values[key] != nil {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		var value json.RawMessage
		if decoder.Decode(&value) != nil || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(value), []byte("null")) {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		values[key] = value
	}
	last, err := decoder.Token()
	if err != nil || last != json.Delim('}') || len(values) != len(fields) {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err = decoder.Token(); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	return values, nil
}
